name: Notability
description: Notability is a note-taking and PDF-annotation workspace for handwriting, typed text, recordings, transcripts, study materials and document markup. People use it across Apple devices and the web to organize notes, capture lectures and meetings, annotate files and share finished work.
agentUseSummary: Notability cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because it publishes no supported account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, local automation interface or remote MCP service. Its supported transfer surfaces are interactive file import and export, link sharing, and user-configured one-way backups through named storage providers.

blocked.label: Connect a Notability account
blocked.description: Notability does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, developer-console or remote MCP connection contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use Notability account data
blocked.description: Notability does not document supported endpoints, schemas, permissions or rate limits for reading or changing a customer's notes through an account API.

blocked.label: Automate the Notability app or private service
blocked.description: Relay will not automate Notability's UI, scrape shared or private pages, reverse engineer private cloud traffic, inspect app containers, or treat exported backup files as a writable Notability account interface.

blocked.label: Proxy through a backup provider
blocked.description: A user-configured one-way backup in Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or WebDAV is an export copy, not delegated Notability authority, and cannot support truthful Notability mutations.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported direct Notability API, local automation contract or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Notability account API, supported local automation interface or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Notability account API, supported local automation interface or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Notability's current official material documents interactive apps, browser access, file import/export, link sharing and one-way third-party backup, but no supported direct account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, local automation interface, developer console or remote MCP service. Its terms also prohibit scraping service data and reverse engineering the service.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Notability only if the provider publishes a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, local automation interface or remote MCP service.

evidence.supports: Notability describes its note-taking, PDF annotation, recording, transcription and study workflows through its interactive applications, with files imported from other apps.
Notability states that notes are device-local by default and describes account, storage, backup and iCloud behavior without publishing a third-party account-access contract.
The official sharing guide documents interactive export to PDF, Note, JPEG, PNG or NTB through connected services or Apple's share menu rather than a programmatic note API.
Notability documents Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and WebDAV as one-way backup destinations and explicitly distinguishes backup copies from the original notes.

Notability's terms prohibit crawling or scraping service data and reverse engineering the service, so Relay must not substitute private web or application automation for a missing supported integration contract.
